name: Kamata Shizue
source:
She's an inpatient at the hospital.
She used to be a hostess at a club called "Club Tinkerbell," but has now retired and is the club's owner.
She seems to be an old acquaintance of Deputy Director Tsuyuzaki, but...

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916134737/http://www.silkys.jp/game/shitai/chara/sizue.html]official website, archived[/url]]
